title: Glisten
description: This modpack makes the animations of Minecraft smoother.
body:
Glisten is a Minecraft Modpack for Fabric that makes Minecraft more fluid and more immersive by using mods and resource packs.

---

## Utility Mods & APIs

**Sodium**: Changes the Game's rendering system, making the game run more smoothly.  
**Iris**: Adds shader support to Fabric to improve the game's visuals.  
**Fabric API & Cloth Config API**: Libraries for the mods.  
**Mod Menu**: Allows you to see all the mods you have, so that you don't have to look in the mods folder.  
**Forge Config API**: A library that can make some forge mods run on Fabric.

---

# Visual content

**Fresh Animations**: Gives mobs and others much more movement, making them more fluid.  
**ETF & EMF**: Remodels the mob to have better joints, essential for Fresh Animations.
**Continuity**: Connects glass and other textures to make the game feel fresher.  
**Chunks Fade In**: Instead of chunks popping in, they fade in.  
**Camera Overhaul**: When turning, it has a camera sway effect so that it feels smoother when turning.  
**Shoulder Surfing**: Adds a new camera mode that is basically freelook.  
**Hold My Items**: Adds new first person animations

---

## Atmosphere & Sound

**AmbientSound**: Adds background sounds to make the game feel more lively. For example, birds chirping.  
**Sound Physics Remastered**:: Adds an echo effect when mining in caves.  

---

## UI enhancements

**Inventory Particles**: Adds particles when interacting with an item in your inventory.
**Smooth Scroll & Smooth GUI**: Adds a smooth interface when swapping in an item slot, and more.  
**Icons**: Adds an icon in front of the text of the GUI
**Colourful Containers**: Adds new GUIs to the game, like crafting and furnace.

---

## Built-in shaders

**Complementary Reimagined**: The most popular shader. Makes Minecraft more aesthetically pleasing while keeping the vanilla style.  
**Visual Vibrance (recommended)**: Makes the game more vibrant, and it doesn't ruin the vanilla feel. Based on Bedrock Shader Vibrant Visuals.
